import type { JSX } from 'solid-js';
import type { DateRangeValue, ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import type { DateModeProps } from './model';
export interface CalendarTranslations {
    previousMonth: string;
    nextMonth: string;
    today: string;
    clear: string;
    cancel: string;
    confirm: string;
    selected: string;
    unavailable: string;
    adjacentMonth: string;
    dateLabel: string;
    monthLabel: string;
    visibleDayLabel: string;
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    weekdays: readonly string[];
    weekdayShort: readonly string[];
    months: readonly string[];
}
interface CalendarBaseProps extends Omit<JSX.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children' | 'onChange' | 'onInput' | 'onSelect'> {
    label?: JSX.Element;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    locale?: 'ko-KR' | 'en-US';
    translations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
    onCancel?: () => void;
}
export type CalendarProps = CalendarBaseProps & (DateModeProps extends infer P ? P extends {
    mode?: 'single';
} ? P & {
    onConfirm?: (details: ValueChangeDetails<string | null>) => void;
} : P & {
    onConfirm?: (details: ValueChangeDetails<DateRangeValue>) => void;
} : never);
/** A native Solid date selector. Selection remains tentative until Confirm. */
export declare function Calendar(props: CalendarProps): JSX.Element;
export {};
